<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="melee-telos" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Melee Telos</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/X0pACbKpyT.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide assumes a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>very</nowiki></strong><nowiki> strong understanding of everything found in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#telos-basic</nowiki></span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide assumes 250%+ and works best at 1000%+, but these rotations still work below 250% with some tweaks. Adjust accordingly from there - below 250%, these rotations can be loosely followed but after that, you definitely want to make sure you follow them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="notable-enrage-checkpoints-and-changes-past-999"><nowiki>Notable Enrage Checkpoints and Changes past 999%</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1000%:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> P4 one rock will fall, P5 multiple rocks will fall, immortality no longer works P5, and Telos will freedom stuns and binds with a 16 tick cooldown</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>2000%:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> &quot;So you think you can guard?&quot; Achievement, aka Silver Warden</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>2700%:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Tendrils damage required caps at 30,000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>3300%:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> The first prayer drain on P3 will smite you from full unless Telos touches the beam</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>4000%:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Hard enrage cap; &quot;The True Warden&quot; Achievement, aka Gold Warden</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
